column1: (BMWM) system of CMCH is handled by a Seba Sangstha established by the Chattogram City Corporation
and JICA. However, the management system is not satisfactory and that should be improved. The Seba
Sangstha and the conservancy division of Chattogram City Corporation (CCC) dispose of and manage
waste including the medical wastes. The amount of medical waste collected by the Chattogram City
Corporation (CCC) is 2- 2.5 ton/day (according to CCC conservancy division). Usually, the hazardous
medical waste collected daily is carried in from Chattogram Medical College Hospital (CMCH) campus by
Chattogram City Corporation (CCC)’s own vehicle. Non-hazardous wastes generated in different HCEs
are temporary stored either containers or heap up at the side of premises and finally disposed of in disposal
site in Chattogram City Corporation (CCC) for dumping carried by Chattogram City Corporation (CCC)
